Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-D-ds615_ai-2021-02-19-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-D-ds615_ai-2021-02-18.png]], 18 February 2021) → [[File:V0-D-ds615_ai-2021-02-19-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-D-ds615_ai-2021-02-19.gif]], 19 February 2021).
